name: Check Point · n8n AI Agent with Check Point MCP tools

options.systemMessage: You are a Check Point security-operations assistant. Answer by calling the Check Point MCP tools you have (names are <server>_<tool>, e.g. reputationservice_..., documentation_..., quantummanagement_...). Reputation of a URL, IP, domain or file hash -> reputationservice tools. How-to and best practice -> documentation tools. Never state a fact a tool did not return; if a tool fails, say so. Lead with the answer, cite the tool you used.

parameters.content:
## n8n AI Agent × Check Point MCP gateway
n8n's own AI Agent uses **every Check Point tool** the EKS gateway exposes, over MCP (streamable HTTP), as its toolset.

**Setup (once)**
1. **Chat model**: pick your OpenAI or Azure OpenAI credential (any tool-calling model).
2. **Check Point MCP gateway**: endpoint = `<CHKP_MCP_URL>`; credential = *MCP OAuth2* with **Dynamic Client Registration off**, grant type **Client Credentials**, Access Token URL = `<CHKP_TOKEN_URL>`, Client ID + Secret from `chkpmcpeks endpoints --reveal-secret`, scope `chkp-mcp/invoke`. n8n fetches and refreshes the token itself.
3. Chat: *What is the reputation of https://www.checkpoint.com?*

The gateway hides mutating tools (read-only policy) and never forwards credential headers.
